definition: This dimension controls the necessity and complexity of tools required for crafting items. Variations can range from requiring no tools at all to needing specific, rare tools for advanced crafting recipes.
exclusion_criteria: Crafting is purely resource-based without any tool influence.
All items can be crafted with a universal tool or no tools required.
inclusion_criteria: Crafting requires specific tools to create items.
Different recipes necessitate different levels or types of tools.
title: Tool Requirements in Crafting Systems
